COST.bull: Costco passes every Buffett and Burry check. Its panel shows positive owner earnings, positive net income, and operating cash flow at least as large as net income across the reported years.
COST.bear: Costco fails Graham’s latest current-ratio requirement because its ratio is 1.06, below the 2.0 threshold. The result shows that a conservative liquidity screen can reject the company even when the other panel checks pass.
